name: myser-receipt-scan-api
description: Standalone Vercel serverless backend for Myser's itemized-receipt LLM proxy (see TICKETS.md MYS-9/MYS-10). Split out from the main app because it needs a real server (holds LLM API keys, enforces scan quota) while the main app is a static Next.js export with no server of its own. Originally built as a Firebase Cloud Function, moved to Vercel because Firebase's Blaze plan (required for Cloud Functions at all, even free-tier usage) wouldn't accept the project owner's payment methods — Vercel's Hobby tier needs no card.
